exceptions.evidence: The renderer calls the pinned printFS directly for this input (upstream/tsc/internal/tsoptions/tsconfigparsing_test.go:1657-1673; matchFilesPrintFS only takes its own branch when the input declares symlinks, and this one declares none), so the order is the pinned walk's and no renderer choice is involved. printFS -> vfs.FS.WalkDir -> upstream/tsc/internal/vfs/internal/internal.go:131-142 -> io/fs.WalkDir. vfstest.MapFS exposes Open (vfstest.go:428) but no ReadDir method, so it is not an fs.ReadDirFS and io/fs.ReadDir sorts the entries itself by DirEntry.Name() with strings.Compare — byte order over the original-case names — whatever useCaseSensitiveFileNames says; that flag only lowercases the internal canonical keys (vfstest.go:206-208). The pin offers no case-aware listing: internal.go:117-128 getEntries goes through the same fs.ReadDir. Byte order puts 'Y' (0x59) before 'x' (0x78) before 'z' (0x7A), which is exactly what the pin produced. First difference at byte 29. This row also carries cause A.
